releases.title: Anonymous usage, if you agree

highlights.title: Help shape BlogPulse
highlights.text: If you agree, BlogPulse sends anonymous counts of the features you use. Nothing else.

highlights.title: Anonymous by design
highlights.text: A random ID made on your phone, never your content, names or accounts.

highlights.title: Your choice, any time
highlights.text: Settings › Privacy turns it on or off, and Send test shows what happened.

changes: Anonymous usage analytics (app-blueprints · usage-analytics 1.1.0): opt-in, anonymous counts to PostHog's US cloud, with a one-time question and Settings › Privacy (switch and Send test)

Events: app_open (layout, theme, ai_key, group_by), blogs_checked (new), post_opened, post_rated (stars), summary_made (provider), story_made, listened (kind, voice), blog_added, invite_made, app_updated
Never sent: blog or post titles, links, text, ratings of named posts, invite text or names

releases.title: Clearer Settings

highlights.title: Sections you can see
highlights.text: Each Settings section now sits in its own card, so you can tell where it starts and ends.

highlights.title: Quieter headings
highlights.text: Section names are small grey capitals, so they no longer look like settings.

highlights.title: In every palette
highlights.text: The cards follow your colours, text size and layout, light or dark.

changes: Settings (app-blueprints · settings 1.1.0): each section's rows sit in one card, with a thin border and a slightly lighter background, under a small muted uppercase heading
The changed-count line and a section's explanation sit outside the cards; Built with is a card too

releases.title: See what AI can do

highlights.title: Discover AI
highlights.text: Without an AI key, a short card now and then shows what AI adds to BlogPulse.

highlights.title: Straight to setup
highlights.text: Turn on AI opens AI settings with Add key highlighted: three steps and you're done.

highlights.title: Never pushy
highlights.text: At most every few days, never over another screen, and Don't remind me again stops it for good.

changes: AI invitation card, shown only while no Claude or OpenAI key is saved: one-line summaries on new posts, the Story and TL;DRs that say why a post matters
Appears after the launch screen and never on a launch that offers an update, over a sheet, the Mark all read dialog or while Listen is playing
Later (or a tap outside the card) brings it back in 3 days, in 7 days after the fourth time; removing your last key brings it back on the next launch
Settings › Built with lists the AI invitation blueprint
A data file that can't be read is copied aside (for example articles.broken-1730000000000.json) and started fresh, with a short note when BlogPulse opens
fixes: Turn on AI highlights Add key on the provider in use: with OpenAI in use, it highlighted Claude's button
One damaged data file no longer stops BlogPulse from saving your changes

releases.title: Read it later

highlights.title: Save for later
highlights.text: Tap the bookmark on any post to keep it on your Read later list.

highlights.title: Done when read
highlights.text: Tap Done to mark a post read and take it off the list.

highlights.title: Clear finished
highlights.text: Remove every saved post you've already read in one tap.

changes: Bookmark on every post, in all layouts; amber when saved
Read later tab with a count, newest saved first, grouped by the day you saved them; shows every saved post whatever topic or blog is selected
Done (or the circle in the Tiny layout) marks the post read and removes it from Read later; Clear finished removes all read ones
Saved posts are never removed for age and are kept first if posts are trimmed

releases.title: Listen to whole articles

highlights.title: Listen on every post
highlights.text: A Listen button reads the full article from the original page.

highlights.title: Progress as you listen
highlights.text: See how far along you are and roughly how many minutes are left.

highlights.title: Tap to jump
highlights.text: Tap anywhere on the progress bar to skip ahead or go back.

changes: Listen button on every post (icon only in the Tiny layout) that reads the full article; falls back to the blog's excerpt if the page can't be read
Progress bar in the player with percentage and time left, using your speed setting or the AI voice's real pace
Tap the bar to jump: iPhone voices restart from that sentence, the AI voice jumps to that second within the current piece

releases.title: No more black screen

highlights.title: Drawn on screen
highlights.text: BlogPulse now builds its page while the window is visible, so iOS draws it.

highlights.title: Redraw on arrival
highlights.text: When your posts arrive, the screen is redrawn to be sure they show.

highlights.title: Start-up log
highlights.text: Settings › Updates shows what happened the last times BlogPulse opened.

changes: An empty dark window appears first; the real page is built inside it while it's visible
The page redraws itself once posts arrive and whenever it comes back into view
The start-up log records what the page reports about itself (visible or not, size)
Settings › Updates › Start-up log shows the last 40 lines
fixes: Black screen when opening from Scriptable, while the page had in fact loaded

releases.title: Opens every time

highlights.title: Always opens
highlights.text: A stuck earlier run can no longer stop BlogPulse from opening.

highlights.title: Patient with iCloud
highlights.text: If iCloud is slow, BlogPulse opens with what it has and saves nothing over your data.

highlights.title: Says what's wrong
highlights.text: If opening ever stalls, the screen shows what BlogPulse was waiting for.

changes: A new run waits at most 1.5 s for an older window, then opens anyway
Reading each data file from iCloud gives up after 10 s instead of waiting forever; files that weren't read are never saved over
Posts are handed to the page in pieces, each with a time limit
A short start-up log is kept on the phone and shown if opening fails
fixes: 1.9.0 could refuse to open after a run that got stuck, showing nothing

releases.title: Opens straight away

highlights.title: No more black screen
highlights.text: BlogPulse shows its launch screen at once and loads your posts behind it.

highlights.title: Safe with quick taps
highlights.text: Tapping the widget several times no longer stacks up copies of the app.

highlights.title: Work waits its turn
highlights.text: Checking blogs and updates starts after the first screen is drawn.

changes: The page is shown before blogs, posts and stories are read from iCloud; a "Loading your posts…" note appears if iCloud is slow
Checking blogs starts 0.7 s after the first screen, the update check after 3.5 s, the widget icon after 6 s
Only one BlogPulse window at a time: a new run waits briefly, and steps aside if one is already open
Closing BlogPulse before posts finish loading never saves over them
fixes: Black screen when opening BlogPulse, especially from the widget or after several taps

releases.title: Your top pick on the Home Screen

highlights.title: A new widget
highlights.text: Your top pick, the latest ✦ Story line and more unread posts, on the BlogPulse logo.

highlights.title: Tap straight to a post
highlights.text: Each unread post in the medium and large widget opens its article.

highlights.title: Never out of date unnoticed
highlights.text: The widget says when blogs were last checked, and turns amber when it's been a while.

changes: Home Screen widget redrawn in the shared frame all the apps use (app-blueprints · widgets 1.0.0): BlogPulse logo and name, "3 new" or "12 unread", the top pick with its reason and blog
Rows: the latest ✦ AI Story line, then other unread posts with their blog, each opening the article
"Scanned 10:05" footer; "All caught up" when everything is read; Lock Screen widgets show the top pick
Settings › Widget: new "Mark the widget as out of date after" (12 hours by default)
The widget still checks your blogs when the last check is old, within its time limit, but no longer changes BlogPulse's own files; otherwise it shows what BlogPulse last saved
Settings › Built with lists the Widgets blueprint

releases.title: Catch up in one tap

highlights.title: Mark all read
highlights.text: Clear every unread post at once from the top of the list.

highlights.title: A warning first
highlights.text: You see how many posts will be marked, and where, before anything changes.

highlights.title: Only this page
highlights.text: On a topic page, a blog or the New tab, only those posts are marked.

changes: Mark all read button above the list, with the unread count for the page
Confirmation sheet explaining the scope and that there's no single undo; tapping outside cancels
Respects the topic page, the selected blog and the New and Picks tabs; hidden on Story and Rated
fixes: Restores the logo and launch screen from 1.6.0, which a mistaken push briefly replaced on GitHub

releases.title: Scan. Read. Rate.

highlights.title: A logo of its own
highlights.text: The pulse feed: a heartbeat through your reading list, a violet dot and a teal new-post line.

highlights.title: Launch screen
highlights.text: The pulse draws itself and the tagline appears for about 2 seconds; tap to skip.

highlights.title: Branded everywhere
highlights.text: The logo sits in the header, on the first-run screen and in the README.

changes: New BlogPulse logo (pulse feed): docs/logo.svg and a 1024 px app icon, docs/icon-1024.png
Launch screen shown for 2.4 s with a short animation and the tagline "Scan. Read. Rate."; tap to skip; still with Reduce Motion (shared launch-screen blueprint 1.0.0)
Logo mark in the header, the logo on the "Follow your first blog" screen, and at the top of the README
Settings › Built with lists the launch-screen blueprint

releases.title: Updates you won't miss

highlights.title: Offered every time
highlights.text: A new version is offered each time you open BlogPulse until you install it.

highlights.title: No accidental snooze
highlights.text: Later, or a tap outside the sheet, no longer hides updates for two days.

highlights.title: Old snooze cleared
highlights.text: A two-day Later left by an older version is removed when BlogPulse starts.

changes: Later hides the update offer only until BlogPulse is opened again
Settings › Updates explains when updates are checked
fixes: Tapping outside the update sheet could hide updates for two days without pressing Later

releases.title: Natural AI voices

highlights.title: AI voice
highlights.text: Have your news and the Story read by OpenAI's natural-sounding voices.

highlights.title: Pick the voice and style
highlights.text: Female or male voices, the speech model, and a style such as "calm newsreader".

highlights.title: See what it uses
highlights.text: Characters read aloud are counted in AI settings, per model and day.

changes: Settings › Listening › Voice engine: iPhone voice or ✦ AI voice (OpenAI speech; needs an OpenAI key)
AI voice settings: voice with Female and Male filters, speech model loaded from your OpenAI account, style instructions for gpt-4o-mini-tts, speed, voice test
All Listen buttons use the chosen engine; the player shows ✦ AI voice and prepares the next piece while one plays
If an AI voice request fails, the iPhone voice takes over from the same place
Token usage shows characters read aloud per model, today and this month; AI settings always opens with fresh counts

releases.title: Listen to your news

highlights.title: Read aloud
highlights.text: Listen to a day's posts, the Story, a TL;DR or a full article.

highlights.title: Your choice of voice
highlights.text: Pick a female or male voice, its speed and pitch, in Settings › Listening.

highlights.title: Player controls
highlights.text: Pause, skip to the next post or stop from the bar at the bottom.

changes: Listen buttons next to each day or week, on the Story, in inline TL;DRs and in the TL;DR panel
Listen to the full article: BlogPulse reads the article page, or the feed excerpt when the page can't be read
Player bar with pause, next and stop; the post being read is highlighted
Settings › Listening: voice menu grouped by language with Female and Male filters, speed, pitch and a voice test
Uses the iPhone's own voices (free, offline); falls back to the system voice when speech isn't available
fixes: The TL;DR hint now points to Settings › AI settings

releases.title: Built with

highlights.title: Built with
highlights.text: A new last section in Settings shows the shared blueprints BlogPulse is built from.

highlights.title: Read how it works
highlights.text: Each blueprint opens at the exact version this release follows.

highlights.title: Same as the other apps
highlights.text: Strava Daily Digest, Dienynas+ and Go2FGym show the same section.

changes: Settings › Built with: In-app updates, Settings and AI configuration, each with its version and the BlogPulse version that brought it in, plus a link to all blueprints
BLUEPRINTS block in the script, so the blueprints inventory can read what BlogPulse follows
docs/BLUEPRINTS.md lists the same blueprints with links and deviations
fixes: Links from Built with open only pages in the blueprints repository

releases.title: Pull down to refresh

highlights.title: Pull to refresh
highlights.text: Pull the list down and hold until the ring fills to check every blog again.

highlights.title: Your hold time
highlights.text: Choose how long to hold, from instant to 5 seconds, in Settings.

highlights.title: No accidental checks
highlights.text: Let go early and nothing happens, so a casual drag never refreshes.

changes: Pull-to-refresh on the post list with a hold ring and status text
New setting: Settings › Checking blogs › Pull-to-refresh hold (0 to 5 seconds, default 1.5)
Pulling is ignored while a sheet is open, during a running check, and for sideways swipes
The refresh button in the header stays as before

releases.title: Your tech blogs, sorted and summarised

highlights.title: Story of your blogs
highlights.text: The latest posts blended into one short, cited read, per topic.

highlights.title: TL;DR in place
highlights.text: Tap TL;DR on any post to read its summary right in the list.

highlights.title: Topic pages
highlights.text: Posts sorted into Tech, AI, Finance and more. Swipe between pages.

changes: Checks every followed blog each time the app opens and marks what's new
Follow blogs by searching or by pasting any address; the RSS or Atom feed is found automatically
Mark read or unread, rate posts 1 to 3 stars, group by day or by week
Picks: unread posts similar to the ones you rate highest
Topic pages sorted by AI or by keywords, with a per-blog override
Story: an AI-written briefing of the latest posts with citations and a TL;DR box
TL;DR on any post, inline; extracted from the article when no AI key is set
Invite to read: an AI-written message in your own words, shared with one tap
Home-screen widget with a short summary and the top pick
Seven colour themes, three layouts, four text sizes, sans or serif headlines
AI settings: Claude or OpenAI key, model picker loaded from your account, token usage per provider, model and feature
Settings screen for every limit and timing, with reset to defaults
In-app updates from GitHub with a two-day Later
